rules.title: Use of os/exec.Command with unsanitized input
rules.recommendation: Validate and sanitize all inputs to exec.Command. Consider using exec.CommandContext for timeout support.

rules.title: Goroutine started without context propagation
rules.recommendation: Pass context.Context to goroutines and use select with ctx.Done() for cancellation.

rules.title: Missing context.Context in function signature
rules.recommendation: Add context.Context as the first parameter and propagate cancellation.

rules.title: Resource opened without defer close
rules.recommendation: Use defer to close resources immediately after opening.

rules.title: HTTP response body not closed
rules.recommendation: Always close http.Response.Body with defer resp.Body.Close().

rules.title: Database connection opened without lifecycle management
rules.recommendation: Use connection pooling (sql.DB). Set connection limits, max lifetime, and ensure Close() on shutdown.

rules.title: Error not checked after function call
rules.recommendation: Do not ignore returned errors with _. Handle errors explicitly.

rules.title: Bare panic call in production code
rules.recommendation: Avoid panic in library/production code. Return errors instead.
